103.description: A team of doctors embarks on a local mission in the Amazon rain forest, but it soon becomes clear that not everybody - or everything - is happy to see them. Their arrival draws the attention of a giant ancient predator, dominant on land and water, who emerges to reclaim the jungle.
details: Jessica Rothe, Logan Marshall-Green, Kiana Madeira
103.title: Beware Boiuna

104.description: A quiet horticulturalist harboring a secret life as a lethal assassin finds his true identity jeopardized when he forms an unlikely friendship with a witnesses to police corruption.
104.title: The Florist

105.description: When a militia of unidentified hostiles coordinates a coup against the U.S., the president uncovers the extent of The Beast's highly classified offensive capabilities in order to save his life and America.
details: Joel Kinnaman, Samuel L. Jackson, Guy Burnet
105.title: The Beast

106.description: The hardest part of ending is starting again. After a seven-year hiatus following the devastating loss of their beloved bandmate, LINKIN PARK’S remaining members struggle to find their way forward. Their shared history and enduring friendship, combined with the fresh perspective of two new band members spark a renewed creative energy that leads them on a transformative journey of artistic reinvention. Following the band from intimate 2022 studio sessions through their explosive November 15, 2024 album release and concert in São Paulo, the film weaves together rare vault footage, electrifying performances from sold-out shows, and candid interviews with band members and fans—capturing the raw, honest story of what it means to start over.
details: Emily Armstrong, Colin Brittain, Brad Delson
106.title: Linkin Park: Unshatter

107.description: Baa: Ek Yoddha" is an upcoming emotional Nepali family drama directed by renowned music composer Hari Lamsal in his directorial debut. The film portrays a father's silent struggles, sacrifices, and unconditional love.
details: Suhana Thapa, Jharana Thapa, Divyadev Pant
107.title: Baa: Ek Yoddha

108.description: A seemingly flawless family at House No. 47 unravels after an incident reveals hidden tensions. As secrets emerge and bonds fray, each member faces the truth behind their perfect facade in this tale of appearances versus reality.
details: Nivetha Pethuraj, Srinidhi Shetty, Venkatesh Daggubati
108.title: Adarsha Kutumbam House No: 47

109.description: The story is set in a picturesque village and follows a single father named Naganna, played by Rangayana Raghu, who raises his farmer son Santhu (Shri Mahadev / Shree Raam). Their lives change when an urban, unconventional woman named Rukmini (Thapaswini Poonacha) enters their lives, testing family trust and generational bonds.
details: Rangayana Raghu, Shri Mahadev, Thapaswini Poonacha, Ramika Shivu
109.title: Premada Oorali

111.description: Set in 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu (Andrew Koji) and Ken Masters (Noah Centineo) are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li (Callina Liang) recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don’t, it’s GAME OVER!
details: Andrew Koji, Noah Centineo, Callina Liang
111.title: Street Fighter

112.description: Phil is an ordinary teenager whose life is overshadowed by personal failures, schoolyard teasing, and the struggles of trying to impress his crush. Everything changes dramatically when he stumbles upon and accidentally opens a hidden portal to go back 65 million years.
112.title: The Dino Family

113.description: Follows a scuba diver who, while looking for his father's remains, is swallowed by an 80-foot, 60-ton sperm whale and has just one hour to get out before his oxygen runs out.
details: Elisabeth Shue, Josh Brolin, Emily Rudd
113.title: Whalefall

114.description: Sense and Sensibility follows sisters Elinor and Marianne Dashwood as they navigate love, heartbreak and societal expectations after their family loses its estate. Despite their contrasting approaches to romance, their unbreakable bond carries them through loss and upheaval towards the possibility of happiness.
details: Caitriona Balfe, Daisy Edgar-Jones, Esmé Creed-Miles
114.title: Sense and Sensibility

116.description: Set in a serene village, Aa Bata Aama 2 is a touching story of family, sacrifice, and ambition. As a son leaves home in pursuit of success, he gradually loses sight of what truly matters. Years later, his return brings a heartbreaking realization about the irreplaceable value of family and the consequences of taking loved ones for granted.
details: Paul Shah, Bipana Thapa, Late Pradeep Rawat
116.title: Aa Bata Aama 2

117.description: A picture-perfect bride transforms a chaotic Meerut household into a slice of heaven, until one suspicious brother-in-law starts connecting the dots. As doubt spreads, the family is forced to confront a chilling possibility: is their ideal bride truly a blessing… or something far beyond their understanding?
details: Yami Gautam, Addinath Kothare Sunita Rajwar, Aaditya Kulshreshth
117.title: Nayyi Navelli

118.description: Follows a rebellious warrior in 1870s South India during the great famine who confronts a British commissioner while protecting his region and people.
details: Rashmika Mandana, Arnold Vosloo, Vijay Devarakinda
118.title: Ranabaali

119.description: Revisits defining criminal trials in Indian history, exploring public prosecutor Ujjwal Nikam's role in legal battles surrounding the 1993 Bombay Blasts and 2008 Mumbai Train Attacks..
details: Jaideep Ahlawat, Wamiqa Gabbi, Rajkummar Rao
119.title: Prahaar: The Untold Story of Ujjwal Nikam

120.description: “Clayface” unravels one man’s horrifying descent from rising Hollywood star to revenge-filled monster in a story that explores the loss of one’s identity and humanity, corrosive love, and the dark underbelly of scientific ambition.
details: Max Minghella, Eddie Marsan, Naomi Ackie, David Dencik
120.title: Clayface

121.description: Based on the bestselling novel from Nobel Prize-winner Kazuo Ishiguro and written and directed by Academy-Award® winner Taika Waititi (Jojo Rabbit), Klara and the Sun introduces audiences to Klara (Jenna Ortega), an Artificial Friend who wants nothing more than to find the perfect home. When Klara meets Josie (Mia Tharia), each immediately senses a kindred spirit in the other. Josie has a fraught relationship with her mother (Amy Adams) and they’ve suffered great loss, but Klara’s innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty begin to heal the family and bring light to Josie’s complicated world.
details: Amy Adams, Jenna Ortega, Mia Tharia
121.title: Klara and the Sun

122.description: Mip, a 12-year-old adopted monkey in a cat-and-rodent world, is transported by a magical map to Empathra. He embarks on a perilous quest to uncover his origins, discovers his empathy power, and restores compassion to the land.
details: Jack McBrayer, Tara Strong, Alan Cumming
122.title: Treasure Trekkers

123.description: As Kaji steps into a new chapter of his life, familiar faces return, and new characters enter his world, each bringing their own motives, desires, and complications. With new dreams and new responsibilities, Kaji faces challenges he never expected.
details: Bipin Karki, Bijay Baral, Dayahang Rai
123.title: Kabaddi 5

124.description: This film is a fun-ride of a life filled with laughter between Antony, who strives hard to become a renowned goon, and his guardian angel Rejimon who enters Antony’s life to make him do only good.
124.title: Titans

125.description: DAUDAAK is a suspense thriller about an aspiring 400-metre athlete whose dream of becoming a National Champion is shattered when he is accused of murder. As he fights to prove his innocence, a web of secrets, motives and shocking revelations unfolds. Who was murdered? Who is the real killer? And why? The truth behind that night is revealed only at the very end.
details: Hardeep Grewal, Malkeet Rauni, Mintu Kappa
125.title: Daudaak

130.description: Accused of a crime he didn't commit and with nothing to lose, a war hero (Liam Neeson) leads law enforcement on a cross-country car chase with the help of his brothers in arms and a sympathetic public rooting for his getaway.
details: Marisa Tomei, Ving Rhames, Liam Neeson
130.title: The Mongoose

131.description: A young tour guide in Luxor accepts an unusual deal from a wealthy businessman: win over his daughter and help her forget her ex. But when things don’t go quite as planned, Hassan finds himself caught in a comical series of unexpected situations, and into a love story he never saw coming.
details: Nour El Nabawy, Yasmine El Abd, Ashraf Abdel Baky
131.title: Wala Kan Ala El-Bal

132.description: An influencer travels to Copenhagen for a documentary about her online fame, but when an obsessive stalker begins tracking her movements, she must confront the terror and reclaim her power.
132.title: The Influencer Project

133.description: The adventures of Prue McKeel as she sets off to the forests outside Portland to find her kidnapped brother.
details: Jacob Tremblay, Carey Mulligan, Peyton Elizabeth Lee
133.title: Wildwood

134.description: Sikandar is a young man from a respected landlord family in Lahore, driven by a hunger for power, respect, and recognition. His ambition leads him into the dangerous world of Malik Gold, a feared and influential crime lord. As Sikandar rises closer to the man he once admired, an unexpected love changes everything—setting him on a collision course where loyalty, ambition, and love come face to face.
details: Javed Sheikh, Yaser Khan, Suzain Fatima
134.title: Delhi Gate

135.description: “DeSu7” is a gripping tale of love and redemption set against the dangerous backdrop of crime, politics and cross-border threats. When fate brings two lost souls together after years apart, a forgotten love reignites amidst a mission that could change everything.
135.title: Desu 7

136.description: Meet the Cat in the Hat you don’t know! In the wonderfully whimsical tradition of Dr. Seuss, The Cat in the Hat comes to the big screen in his animated theatrical feature film debut, an all-new, epic adventure with an edge, where mischief, magic and mayhem reign supreme.
details: Bill Hader, Xochitl Gomez, Matt Berry
136.title: The Cat In The Hat

137.description: Alec lives under a repressive society that monitors his every movement, while working at the central avatar store — a symbol of the EyeLight technological revolution he viscerally resists. His isolation is disrupted by Jade, an equally rebellious figure who plays the system far more strategically. Their unfolding forbidden relationship will push both of them to the very brink.
137.title: The Draw

138.description: War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life.
138.title: Godzilla Minus Zero

139.description: In an age of gods and kings, the fate of worlds hangs in the balance. Rama, a prince bound by duty, sacrifice, and righteousness, must confront Ravana, an immortal ruler driven by pride and vengeance, powerful enough to shatter the cosmos.
139.title: Ramayana

140.description: No synopsis is currently available for this movie, please check back soon.
140.title: How to Rob a Bank

141.description: An epic new take on Victor Hugo's timeless classic.
details: Tahar Rahim, Vincent Lindon, Noémie Merlant
141.title: Les Misérables

142.description: An eccentric governess (Maika Monroe) arrives at a remote gothic manor, where strange happenings stir suspicion that she's not what she seems.
details: Jason Isaacs, Maika Monroe, Thomasin McKenzie
142.title: Victorian Psycho

143.description: THE HUNGER GAMES: SUNRISE ON THE REAPING revisits the world of Panem and follows young Haymitch Abernathy (Joseph Zada) twenty-four years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the Fiftieth Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.
details: Ralph Fiennes, Jesse Plemons, Joseph Zada
143.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping

144.description: This November, comedy icon and Emmy winner Ben Stiller and two-time Oscar® winner Robert De Niro reunite, joined by Grammy winner and Oscar® nominee Ariana Grande, in Focker-In-Law, a new chapter in the blockbuster Meet the Parents franchise. Written and directed by John Hamburg, who co-wrote the three previous Meet the Parents films, Focker-In-Law is produced by Oscar® nominee Jane Rosenthal and Robert De Niro for Tribeca Productions; Ben Stiller and Oscar® winner John Lesher for Red Hour Films.
details: Robert De Niro, Owen Wilson, Ariana Grande, Ben Stiller
144.title: Focker In-Law

145.description: An awkward teen and her Type-A mother learn her peculiarities might be magical powers, transforming their lives and revealing a hidden magical realm.
details: Rashida Jones, Hailee Steinfeld, Stephen Fry
145.title: Hexed

146.description: If you’re nice, you get presents from the Big Guy. If you’re naughty, you get justice. But when Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he’ll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus.
146.title: Violent Night 2

147.description: Dune: Part Three is based on the novel Dune Messiah by Frank Herbert and delivers the epic conclusion to Villeneuve’s trilogy.
details: Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya ,, Jason Momoa, Florence Pugh
147.title: Dune: Part Three

148.description: Seeking answers about her family's tragedy, Naya receives messages from beyond through her sister Anna's final voice note. What begins as an attempt to reconnect with the spirit turns into a spiral of terror: the same entity that possessed Anna now seeks Naya as its new host, leading both siblings on a descent into madness, where the line between the living and the dead disappears.
148.title: Voice Message

149.description: In the epic fantasy world of Orïsha, a young woman goes on a quest to reclaim the magic that was violently stolen from her people. She and her brother ally with the daughter and son of the king to fight back against his brutal rule. Directed by Gina Prince-Bythewood, CHILDREN OF BLOOD AND BONE features a stellar cast including Thuso Mbedu, Damson Idris, Amandla Stenberg, Tosin Cole, featuring Academy Award® nominee Cynthia Erivo, Lashana Lynch, Zackary Momoh, Richard Mofe-Damijo, Academy Award® nominee Chiwetel Ejiofor, Academy Award® winner Regina King, with Idris Elba and Academy Award® winner Viola Davis.
details: Amandla Stenberg, Tosin Cole, Damson Idris, Thuso Mbedu
149.title: Children of Blood and Bone

150.description: When JJ starts kindergarten, his first big day takes an unexpected turn after his beloved teddy bear, Boba, goes missing. Joined by his friends Cody, CeCe and Nina, JJ embarks on a magical adventure to the Kingdom of Melody, where singing has been forbidden by Princess Harmony. Along the way, the friends discover the power of courage, friendship and finding their own voices. Featuring ten brand-new songs, CoComelon: The Movie brings the beloved world of CoComelon to the big screen in an all-new musical adventure for the whole family.
details: SZA ,, Ike Barinholtz, Connor Esterson, Sarah Sherman
150.title: Cocomelon: The Movie

151.description: Indebted to a feline mob boss, a black cat named Nero finds himself forced to forge an unexpected friendship that may finally lead him to his purpose.
details: Mark Ruffalo, Laurence Fishburne, Ismail Elsene
151.title: Gatto

152.description: No synopsis is currently available for this movie, please check back soon.
details: Michael B. Jordan, Kenneth Branagh, Adria Arjona
152.title: The Thomas Crown Affair

153.description: An enigmatic stranger forms an unlikely bond with a grieving bartender who lost her lover, their lives intertwining in unexpected ways.
details: Johnny Depp, Penélope Cruz, Madelyn Cline
153.title: Day Drinker

154.description: Jailer 2 follows retired jailer Tiger Muthuvel Pandian (Rajinikanth) as a new threat from the criminal underworld shatters his peaceful life, forcing him to return to his ruthless ways to protect his family and legacy
154.title: Jailer 2

156.description: After a banker is sentenced to life in Shawshank Prison, he forms an unlikely friendship with a seasoned inmate and clings to hope amid cruelty and corruption.
details: Clancy Brown, Tim Robbins, Morgan Freeman
156.title: The Shawshank Redemption (Re-release)

159.description: Follows Frances Haugen, a young Facebook engineer, who enlisted the help of Jeff Horwitz, a Wall Street Journal reporter, to blow the whistle on the social network's most guarded secrets
details: Betty Gilpin, Mikey Madison, Wunmi Mosaku, Jeremy Allen White
159.title: The Social Reckoning

160.description: DreamWorks Animation's Forgotten Island follows lifelong best friends Jo and Raissa, who are about to embark on separate life paths after graduating high school. During one final night together, they discover a mysterious portal that transports them to the magical island of Nakali, a world filled with mythical creatures from Filipino folklore. Alongside the lovable weredog Raww and an unlikely group of allies, they must confront the island's most feared creature, the Dreaded Manananggal. But when they learn that the price of returning home is the loss of every memory of their friendship, Jo and Raissa must race against time to escape the island before they forget each other forever.
details: Jenny Slate, Liza Soberano, Dave Franco, H. E. R -, Manny Jacinto
160.title: Forgotten Island

50.description: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity’s saviour before the disaster he’s unleashed destroys everything.
details: Tom Cruise, Sandra Hüller, Riz Ahmed
50.title: Digger

51.description: Vijay Salgaonkar’s carefully hidden secret comes under threat as new evidence brings the truth closer to his family. As the investigation intensifies, Vijay must once again use his intelligence to protect his loved ones and keep the past buried.
51.title: Drishyam: The Conclusion

52.description: Adapted from Colleen Hoover's best-selling novel, this seductive, psychological thriller follows renowned author Verity Crawford (Anne Hathaway) and Lowen Ashleigh (Dakota Johnson), a struggling writer who relocates to the remote Crawford estate to ghostwrite for Verity. After Lowen uncovers what appears to be Verity's chilling autobiographical notes, she wrestles with the disturbing and twisted confessions about Verity’s husband Jeremy (Josh Hartnett) - struggling to separate fiction from reality, manipulation from attraction, and opportunity from obsession.
details: Anne Hathaway, Dakota Johnson, Josh Hartnett
52.title: Verity

53.description: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont (Brad Pitt) and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements. From acclaimed filmmaker David Ayer, Heart of the Beast is an intense adventure thriller that explores the unbreakable bond between a man and his best friend as they face their greatest battle yet.
details: Brad Pitt, J.K Simmons, Anna Lambe
53.title: Heart of the Beast

54.description: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War (2018), the universe is in ruins. With the help of remaining allies, the Avengers assemble once more in order to reverse Thanos' actions and restore balance to the universe.
details: Chris Hemsworth, Robert Downey Jr, Josh Brolin, Chris Evans
54.title: Avengers Endgame: Encore (Infinity Vision)

55.description: From the mind of visionary filmmaker Zach Cregger (Weapons, Barbarian) comes a thrilling — and terrifying — reinvention of the Resident Evil franchise. In an all-new story, Resident Evil follows Bryan (Austin Abrams), a medical courier who unwittingly finds himself in an action-packed, non-stop race for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.
details: Austin Abrams, Zach Cherry, Kali Reis
55.title: Resident Evil

56.description: The Odyssey - In Cinemas 16.07.26 Christopher Nolan’s next film, The Odyssey, is a mythic action epic shot across the world using brand new IMAX® film technology. The film brings Homer’s foundational saga to IMAX® film screens for the first time and opens in cinemas everywhere on July 16, 2026. The Odyssey stars Matt Damon, Tom Holland, Anne Hathaway, Robert Pattinson and Lupita Nyong’o, with Zendaya and Charlize Theron. The Odyssey is produced by Emma Thomas and Christopher Nolan for their company, Syncopy. The executive producer is Thomas Hayslip.
details: Robert Pattinson, Anne Hathaway, Zendaya ,, Tom Holland, Matt Damon
56.title: The Odyssey

57.description: Join the Smurfs in a collection of fun-filled adventures packed with wild inventions, thrilling competitions, teamwork, and chaotic missions. From sports contests to hilarious encounters with Gargamel, the Smurfs discover that friendship and courage always save the day.
57.title: The Smurfs Timeless Adventure Volume 2

58.description: Follows a woman constable who joins the police force through appointment after the death of her husband.
58.title: Pradhama Drishtya Kuttakkar

59.description: A story set in the ACME warehouse, the manufacturer of anything and everything used by the Looney Tunes characters.
details: John Cena, Will Forte, Lana Condor
59.title: Coyote VS Acme

60.description: Suri, a quirky street magician in Hyderabad who accidentally casts a spell that makes a young girl disappear, only to discover she is a powerful genie
details: Saurabh Sachdeva, Fahadh Faasil, Ssara Palekar
60.title: Don't Trouble The Trouble

61.description: Seven Seas Seven Hills is a captivating tale narrated by a mysterious woman to a curious boy on a train. The tale unfolds on a rainy night when a chance encounter with a rat sets off a chain of events that intertwines the fates of a 32-year-old ordinary man and an 8,000-year-old immortal man during a train journey. As the ordinary man grapples with survival, the immortal man seeks to heal his heart from centuries-old wounds. The narrative unfolds moral dilemmas, culminating in a climactic confrontation. Will the immortal man's tortured soul find closure and reunite with the love of his life? Will the ordinary man transform into a compassionate extraordinary man? Will the rat survive the night?
61.title: Yezhu Kadal Yezhu Malai

62.description: Set in Madras in 1986, the film follows a timid eight-year-old boy who accidentally traps a feared gangster inside a deserted school toilet. As the gangster confronts hunger, loneliness and his own vulnerability, an unexpected bond develops between them, changing both their lives forever.
62.title: Baththa

63.description: Follows Avarachan, his children and the various family and social relationships that shape their lives.
63.title: Avaraachan & Sons

64.description: In 1980s Secunderabad, a marginalized tribe battles discrimination and fights for citizenship under an unexpected leader's guidance, challenging systemic oppression.
64.title: The Paradise

65.description: A rational urban man defies his ancestral village's forbidden forest and awakens a divine goddess, forcing him to confront powers beyond logic as he becomes the unlikely saviour protecting his people from annihilation.
details: Sidharth Malhotra, Tamannaah Bhatia, Anup Soni
65.title: The Vvaan: Force of the Forrest

66.description: It's a BRAND NEW DAY for Peter Parker. Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn’t remember him -- and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him -- sparks a change in Peter he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.
details: Zendaya ,, Tom Holland, Jacob Batalon, Sadie Sink
66.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day

67.description: Shish Dou is a comedy-drama that unfolds over the course of a single night, exposing the fragility of different social classes. Two middle-aged friends, Adel and Nabil, reunited after years of hardship, stumble upon Tarek, a wealthy young man who is unconscious after a fight. Driven by poverty, fear, and desperation, they impulsively decide to kidnap him for ransom. What begins as an amateur crime spirals into a chaotic and absurd situation. Meanwhile, the powerful and calculating Helal, a local fixer and influential figure, sees Tarek’s disappearance as an opportunity to expand his control over Tarek’s family and a debt-ridden businessman named Gamal. As tensions escalate between the kidnappers, the wealthy family, and Helal, the story becomes a sharp exploration of class conflict, power, and moral collapse.
details: Bayyoumy Fouad, Bassem Samra, Michel Milad
67.title: Shish Dou

68.description: A grieving boy seeks God to meet his departed mother, and in finding the divine, learns to serve humanity with miracles of love, food and silent blessings, becoming Hanuman Ansh, Neem Karoli Baba.
details: Shobhinaw Satyaa, Vihaan Shedge, Chandan Anand
68.title: Hanuman Ansh

69.description: Oli, Tad’s intrepid two-year-old daughter, has turned him into an overprotective father and Mummy feels sidelined by the attention she gets. When they find the magic lamp in Buckingham Palace, Mummy asks it to travel back in time to Paititi, Peru, in 1502. Tad, Sara and the whole team will have to follow Mummy into the past, before he changes history… Their journey will take them across the Atlantic Ocean from Peru to Greece, and from there deep into the Middle East, all the way to the cave of Ali Baba and the Forty Thieves.
details: Joseph Balderrama, Óscar Barberán, Michelle Jenner
69.title: Tad and the Magic Lamp

70.description: MIRZAPUR’s throne gives great power to whoever controls it. There are existing players. Akhandanand Tripathi – who sits on it, Munna Tripathi – the heir apparent, Rati Shankar Shukla – the don of Jaunpur. And Guddu and Bablu – the two brothers who arrived like a hurricane and changed the dynamics irreversibly. Forever and then, there is the new claimant who appears in this saga of bloodshed and violence. Babban ‘Babua’ – from the deserts of Jaisalmer, and with a past connection with Mirzapur. A violent and ruthless man whose weapon is a pair of scissors. Mirzapur The Movie showcases this power tussle, splashed with blood and revenge.
70.title: Mirzapur

71.description: Practical Magic 2 returns to a world steeped in moonlit mischief and powerful ancestral magic, as the Owens sisters must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all in a must-see cinematic event of fun, magic and mayhem.
details: Nicole Kidman, Sandra Bullock, Joey King
71.title: Practical Magic 2

72.description: In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, and with the fate of the free world hanging in the balance, Pressure follows General Dwight D. Eisenhower and Captain James Stagg as they face an impossible choice—launch the largest and most dangerous seaborne invasion in history or risk losing the war altogether.
details: Andrew Scott, Kerry Condon, Brendan Fraser
72.title: Pressure

73.description: Follows a couple with a significant age difference as they navigate their romantic relationship.
details: Nivin Pauly, Mamitha Baiju, Sangeeth Prathab
73.title: Bethlehem Kudumba Unit

74.description: Grieving her sister Shiloh's death, Jax Hunter bonds with Shiloh's bold friend Luce. They tackle Mount Kwan's dangerous plank walk in Thailand. When a rockslide traps them on a narrow plank 3000 feet up, Jax must face her fears to survive.
details: Grace Caroline Currey, Virginia Gardner, Harriet Slater
74.title: Fall 2: Deadpoint

75.description: Having earned over $740 million at the global box office, the Insidious franchise returns with a new family and a terror that redefines what The Further is capable of. In Insidious: Out of the Further, Amelia Eve stars as Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in who discovers she can travel into The Further, the purgatorial realm of lost souls at the heart of the Insidious universe. When something evil comes after her, Gemma discovers an ability that changes everything: she doesn’t just enter The Further, she can bring what lives there back to the real world. Once the demons realize her power, our world becomes their playground.
details: Amelia Eve, Brandon Perea, Maisie Richardson-Sellers
75.title: Insidious: Out Of The Further

76.description: After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.
details: McKenna Grace, Carter Young, Terry Crews
76.title: Paw Patrol: The Dino Movie

77.description: A fishing captain applies his maritime knowledge in a traditional boat race along Tamil Nadu's coast during a festival, leading a six-person team against other crews.
77.title: Mandaadi

78.description: A flight attendant poses as a commercial captain to charm women. When he falls in love with Habiba, he decides to settle down. Due to tight flight shifts, he grants his father a power of attorney to execute the wedding contract—only to end up married to four women simultaneously! When his father suffers temporary amnesia, Hesham embarks on a race against time to untangle the three extra marriages before Habiba discovers the chaos.
details: Nesreen Amin, Jamila Awad, Ahmed Hatem
78.title: Red Flag

80.description: Mumbai, 2023. Bhagirath “Bugs” Bhargav is a sincere software engineer whose orderly life is constantly disrupted by his reckless yet lovable best friend, Hardik Sharma. Hoping to help him turn over a new leaf, Bugs gets Hardik a job at his company, where an unexpected romance begins to bloom. But when a high-stakes intelligence operation collides with their ordinary lives, the two friends are thrust into a world of espionage, deception, and escalating chaos. Completely out of their depth, Bugs and Hardik must survive a mission they were never meant to be part of—because sometimes, the fate of a nation rests in the most unlikely hands.
details: Kunal Kemmu, Preity G. Zinta, Sparsh Shrivastava
80.title: Vibe

81.description: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War (2018), the universe is in ruins. With the help of remaining allies, the Avengers assemble once more in order to reverse Thanos' actions and restore balance to the universe.
details: Chris Hemsworth, Robert Downey Jr, Josh Brolin, Chris Evans
81.title: Avengers Endgame: Encore

82.description: Rajan and Chalu mother and son live in a squatter settlement on the banks of the Khudi River. The story progresses from the events after the untimely death of Rajan's father Ganga Bahadur due to the burden of debt. A moneylender comes looking for a house to collect the money that Ganga Bahadur has eaten. In the furnace of Kali, Ganga gives the pension lease to Rajan and goes with the promise of coming to collect the money in a few days.
